mentions.name: Basketball Nations
mentions.description: A VR basketball game for Meta Quest, a rewritten version of the author's older basketball game with updated gameplay and graphics, focused on international tournaments; player and tournament names are not licensed so they are not fully real.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm polishing my new VR games (Meta Quest). Actually they're just rewritten versions of my older games (one Soccer and one Basketball), but now focused on international tournaments with updated gameplay and graphics. I have no licensing for the player names and tournament names are also not fully real for same reason.
mentions.author: random-exceptio
